sections.heading: What Are the Benefits of Health Insurance?
sections.text: A health insurance policy provides a comprehensive scope of coverage that underlines the various benefits that you can avail of. Have a look at some Mediclaim Insurance benefits -

sections.heading: Family Cover
sections.text: Choose family floater plans and get coverage for all your family members. One policy allows umbrella coverage to all your loved ones, so that if anyone falls ill, the policy covers the medical costs. This means that you can rest assured that your family will be taken care of, even in your absence. Some family cover plans also work out to be more affordable, rather than getting individual plans for each family member.

sections.heading: Free health check-ups
sections.text: Health insurance plans motivate you to keep regular track of your health. They allow coverage for free health check-ups at regular intervals to keep a tab on your health and catch complications early on. Buying

sections.heading: How To Choose The Right Health Insurance Plan?
sections.text:
With so many Aditya Birla health insurance plans available, choosing the right plan can prove to be a difficult job. But, with the right checklist, you will be prepared to make the right selection.
Here are some quick parameters to find the right
health insurance plan in India

sections.heading: The right sum insured
sections.text: Medical costs are increasing, every day. So, make sure you choose an optimal sum insured which proves sufficient to cover the exorbitant medical costs. Remember that life expectancy is also increasing, so you may need to plan for health insurance for a longer period.

sections.heading: The right coverage benefits
sections.text: Check the coverage benefits that the health insurance plans offer. Choose a plan which offers the most inclusive scope of coverage that also matches your needs. It's tempting to pick a policy with the least premium, but make sure you check the coverage benefits first.

sections.heading: The right premium
sections.text: Nothing is more important than affordable premiums. So, check the coverage and ensure that the premium is commensurate with the coverage provided. Also, ensure that the premium is affordable for you. Since premiums will need to be paid every year or every few years (depending on the terms of the policy), make sure you keep funds aside so that you don't have to run around at the last minute.
